Overview

Ouagadougou is a city in Centre with a population of 2,500,000. Ouagadougou is a major city in Burkina Faso with a population of 2,500,000. Housing costs are close to the national average. The overall cost of living is above the national average. Gardening thrives here — the 7a growing zone supports Mild — wide variety of vegetables, many fruit trees.
